tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactorily completed, at least one similar Contract of Providing Services of SERVICE MANPOWER OUTSOURCE BASIS FOR SWM SECTION and the contract amount of Rs 13.57 lakhs ie., 50 percent of Tender amount
Attested copy of the Certifcate of registration in the Labour Department Provident Fund and ESI Organizations GST
Attested copy of the Balance sheet & Profit & Loss A/c of the Service Provider for the last three years (2023-24 to 2025-26) prepared and audited by a Chartered Accountant
Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than 30 percent of the estimated cost

To Qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of the estimate cost
